'''2008 Coruscant Regionals''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG regional championship held on 23 August 2008 in New York City, with [[Premiere - Original VS16|Virtual Set 16]] legal; eighteen players took part.<ref name="pcf-21345-330601">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330601#330601 Coruscant Regionals - Aug 23rd in NYC - v16 is legal], JasonRed3, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080917023601/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334505 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Mike Gemme]] won with a Tanks deck.<ref name="pcf-21345-330630">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330630#330630 Coruscant Regionals - Aug 23rd in NYC - v16 is legal], Mike Gemme (deck104), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080917023601/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334505 Internet Archive]</ref> The event carried two automatic bids to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]].<ref name="pcf-21345-332114">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=332114#332114 Coruscant Regionals - Aug 23rd in NYC - v16 is legal], simone89, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080917023601/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334505 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]] (the topic title reads "v16 is legal")<ref name="pcf-21345-330601" />
* '''Site:''' New York City<ref name="pcf-21345-330601" />
* '''Dates:''' 23 August 2008<ref name="pcf-21345-330601" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Mike Gemme]]<ref name="pcf-21345-330630" />

== Results ==

A player posting as JasonRed3 reported that "18 players showed up in the city... 18 players hungry for glass and a travel voucher!" and hoped the event would start a New York City revival.<ref name="pcf-21345-330601" /> Replying to congratulations on his win, Gemme wrote that he would have run the Tanks deck before Virtual Set 16 anyway.<ref name="pcf-21345-330630" /> A player posting as mikefrench congratulated "gemme and desai"; [[Justin Desai]]'s place is not given.<ref name="pcf-21345-330591">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330591#330591 Coruscant Regionals - Aug 23rd in NYC - v16 is legal], mikefrench, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080917023601/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334505 Internet Archive]</ref> The results were posted in the forum's results thread, under the Corellia regionals heading by mistake, and the decklists were to be scanned.<ref name="pcf-21345-330990">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330990#330990 Coruscant Regionals - Aug 23rd in NYC - v16 is legal], JarJarDrinks, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080917023601/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334505 Internet Archive]</ref> On 29 August a player asked to whom the two Worlds Day 2 automatic bids had passed down; no answer appears in the topic as captured.<ref name="pcf-21345-332114" /> The Players Committee's list of Day 2 automatic bids, posted the same day, gives them to [[Lee Edwards]] and [[Bill Kafer]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>
